title: Screen reader heading navigation in WebAIM 2023-24 survey
statement:
In WebAIM's 2023-24 survey of 1,539 screen reader users, 71.6% said they first navigate through the headings when looking for information on a long page and 88.8% found heading levels very or somewhat useful, so landing page sections need real, hierarchical heading elements with descriptive text rather than merely styled text.

Options:
- Clean heading hierarchy: One h1 stating the page's main value proposition, then an h2 per major section and h3 for sub-parts, with no skipped levels (fits: clear, professional, editorial)
- Descriptive headings: Descriptive heading text that makes sense out of context (for example 'Pricing plans', not 'Learn more') (fits: clear, trustworthy, practical)
- Headings plus landmarks: Landmark elements (header, nav, main, footer) in addition to headings, since 31.7% of respondents use landmarks often or always when present (fits: technical, organized, polished)
- Skip link: A working skip link to main content at the top of the page (fits: accessible, careful, professional)
appliesWhen: Applies to: general web. Audience: general.
